_note: Table photographs that some pins lay the real puzzle pages on. They were made for Hearth & Clue with an AI image model on 6 October 2026 and show no real people, brands or text. 'scene' is how the alt text describes the picture; 'card' is the colour of the panels the words sit on; 'stack' moves or shrinks the pages when something in the picture should stay in view.
